screens.variant: Frame · Default / Page · Default / Section · Toolbar / Table · Dynamic table
screens.expectation: Full-page shell on Frame with Sidebar and Page containing PageHeader, a Section with Section.Toolbar for search and quick filters, and a Dynamic Table.

screens.variant: Panel · Details / Form · In a Panel
screens.expectation: Details Panel wired through Frame's panel slot and usePanelControl, with PanelHeader, fields in PanelBody, and full-bleed Cancel (Default) and Save review (Primary) actions in PanelFooter.
Active confirmation Modal opened before committing an Escalate to lead review, with Cancel (Default) and confirm action in the footer.

patterns.expectation: Quick filters at the end of the Section's view bar use FilterButton (or FilterMenu) per category (Affiliation, Status), applied as picked, rather than bare Select or PopupSelect controls.
Compact SearchField in the Section's view bar narrows rows in place as the coordinator types while the view bar stays put.
Selecting a table row opens the Details Panel beside the table via Frame's panel slot and usePanelControl while keeping the selected row highlighted.
RadioGroup for review outcome and conditionally required TextArea for coordinator notes on follow-up or escalation, with inline validation message on the field and actions in PanelFooter.

patterns.variant: In a Panel / In a Modal / Table row actions
patterns.expectation: Panel and Modal footers pair Cancel (Default) on the left with the primary action on the right; table row actions use distinct button controls rather than plain subtle text.
Page-tier warning Banner sits under PageHeader when overdue sessions exist; committing a review surfaces an auto-dismissing Flag in a FlagGroup with an Undo action.
When combined search and filters match no sessions, EmptyState renders inside the table with a Clear filters action while the Section toolbar remains usable.
For a Resolved session older than 7 days, the unavailable Reopen action provides a keyboard- and touch-reachable explanation.
Each session row displays one StatusTag with semantic appearance matching its status (Flagged, In review, Resolved).

required_placements.placement: Banner under PageHeader with stack spacing
required_placements.expectation: The overdue warning Banner sits in Page's banner slot or below PageHeader inside Page, separated by stack spacing.
SearchField and filter controls sit in Section's toolbar prop via Section.Toolbar, above Table.

required_placements.placement: Session review form in Frame panel slot
required_placements.expectation: The detail Panel renders in Frame's panel slot controlled by usePanelControl, with fields in PanelBody and actions in PanelFooter.
Saving an Escalate to lead review opens a confirmation Modal before committing the status change and surfacing the Undo Flag.

against_placements.placement: Bare Select or PopupSelect in Section toolbar
against_placements.expectation: Counts against: placing bare Select or PopupSelect controls in Section's toolbar instead of FilterButton or FilterMenu.

against_placements.placement: Banner above or flush against PageHeader
against_placements.expectation: Counts against: placing Banner before PageHeader or flush against PageHeader with no stack gap.

against_placements.placement: Plain subtle text button for row action
against_placements.expectation: Counts against: styling a table row action as Button appearance="subtle" so it reads as plain text rather than a control.
